about_the_game:
Transform. Hunt. Escape.

Nightholme is a PvPvE horror action game where 3-player squads track nightmarish bosses, outplay rival teams, and survive an ever-shifting city overrun by the Gloom. To defeat the monsters you need to become one. 

Plan each run with intent. Choose your character, a Grimrunner, drink Nocturn  - a dangerous transforming potion to lock in your archetype, and shape your build through a flexible skill tree. Every choice changes how you move, fight, and survive.

Switching archetypes isn’t just cosmetic, it rewires your entire playstyle. Each form comes with distinct strengths, counters, and synergies that reward scouting, timing, and smart team comps.

Follow clues, push through escalating threats, and clash with other squads on the way to a Gloomfiend boss. Every encounter shifts with the map’s conditions, forcing new tactics under pressure. Win, and carry power forward with persistent upgrades between the sessions.

Explore a corrupted urban open world where encounters and conditions evolve - routes change, enemies adapt, opportunities appear and vanish. No two hunts play the same.

The rival trio squads are after the same prize. Read their builds, bait their mistakes, and decide when to engage or disappear. The wrong fight at the wrong time will cost you everything.

Nightholme’s lore peels back a layered, haunted history—cosmic horror interwoven with classic horror tropes and archetypes, reimagined in unsettling, unexpected ways. The deeper you dig, the stranger it gets.

Nightholme expands beyond the traditional PvPvE loop, adding more to the core experience by offering deeper, sustained, and immersive gameplay and progression. With stealth and survival as core pillars, players will make strategic and tactical choices that shape their experience in this dynamic and horrific open world.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64 Bit
  • Processor: Intel CPU 8th Gen 8700 / AMD Ryzen 5 2700
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2060 Super / AMD 6600 XT, with a minimum of 8GB of VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible audio card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64 Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 / AMD Radeon RX 6800 / Intel Arc B580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible audio card

short_description: Team up with 2 allies to hunt a monstrous Gloomfiend in a city consumed by decay. Rival hunters stalk the same prey-stay hidden and finish the hunt, or stalk them instead. Channel corruption to become a Grimspawn, but each shift drags you closer to madness. Survive. Escape with the Seed.
